observations.summary: Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted Iranian drones after a shelter alert; the IRGC said it targeted a US radar at Sheikh Isa Air Base. Reuters reports no casualties or damage. This is a separate Tuesday episode from Sunday's Al-Rifaa attacks; exact engagement time and any target damage remain unverified. Oman-Iran maritime diplomacy is contrary escalation context.
observations.title: Bahrain reports intercepting new Iranian drone attack directed at Sheikh Isa base

observations.summary: Crimean Russian-installed governor reported a second-day Ukrainian strike and suspension of Kerch Bridge traffic. Damage extent is unknown; Ukraine had not commented at initial Reuters publication. Russian Defense Ministry claimed 1,441 drones intercepted across 22 regions, unverified independently. This is ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict infrastructure attrition, not evidence of a new Russia-NATO attack.
observations.title: Russian-installed Crimean authorities report second consecutive strike and bridge traffic suspension
